title: Approve or deny
text: Approve personally only when the four-character code matches your terminal and the machine and organization are yours. yoke machines approve CODE shows the deciding identity and machine; yoke machines deny CODE refuses the request. Approval grants the approving person's identity; service routing grants no approval authority. Success has a separate Return to your terminal callout. Denial and expiry authorize nothing; unavailable codes offer entry again. Expiry does not renew a code.
